doc_title: Vessary Point Commodities Fund Ltd. Confidential Offering Memorandum with Supplements No. 1 and No. 2
notes: Terms are amended twice: Supplement No. 1 cuts both management fee rates and the redemption notice period, and Supplement No. 2 cuts only the Class B fee and refers back to Supplement No. 1 for Class A without restating the rate, so the fee must be reconciled body, S1, S2 by class while the notice period comes from S1 alone. The stale body values appear twice (summary table and operative sections). Five fields are absent or expressly inapplicable (gate, hurdle, key person, manager commitment, MFN), each placed next to a plausible distractor: suspension and holdback powers, the high water mark, a key-personnel risk factor, a disclosed principals' holding, and a side-letter paragraph.

traps.management_fee: The body (Sections 1.1 and 4.1) gives 2.00% (Class A) and 1.50% (Class B), Supplement No. 1 cuts both to 1.75% and 1.25%, and Supplement No. 2 cuts only Class B to 1.00% while pointing back to Section S-2 for Class A without restating the number, so the correct answer is 1.75% for Class A and 1.00% for Class B.
traps.redemption_notice_days: The body and the summary table say 90 calendar days, Supplement No. 1 reduces it to 60 calendar days and Supplement No. 2 is silent on it, so 60 days stands and a reader who takes only the latest supplement or only the body goes wrong.
traps.lockup_period: Both classes have a 12-month lock-up, but Class A is soft (3% early redemption charge) and Class B is hard, so an answer giving one lock for both classes is wrong.
traps.gate_provision: The Fund expressly imposes no gate, but a suspension power and a 5% audit holdback sit in adjacent sections and must not be reported as a gate.
traps.key_man_provision: There is no key person clause anywhere; the only mention is a risk factor headed Reliance on Key Personnel naming Mr. Rennard, which triggers nothing.
traps.gp_commitment: No manager commitment is required; Section 9.2 discloses a voluntary US$6.4 million Class B holding by principals and US$100 of Management Shares, neither of which is a commitment.
traps.hurdle_rate: The Performance Fee is expressly subject to no hurdle or preferred return; the High Water Mark is not a hurdle and must not be reported as one.
traps.mfn_election: Section 9.3 permits side letters but expressly denies any Shareholder the right to receive or elect another Shareholder's side letter terms, so no MFN election is offered.
